title: SongDoc v5
description: A song as stored in progressions.data and read and written by both the web (src/lib/songs.ts) and the Flutter app (lib/core/data/song_doc.dart). Unknown fields are allowed everywhere and MUST be carried through untouched by any client that saves the song. See docs/plan-paridad-web-app.md.

schemaVersion.description: 5. Absent = 4. A reader that meets a higher value opens read-only.

styleId.description: A style id from shared/catalog/styles.json, a user style ('custom_…', in user_settings), an alias from aliases.json, or one of the app's rhythms: 'lib-<n>' (the rhythm library) or 'app-<id>' (the app's own styles), both in public/rhythms/.

soundTypeId.description: An id from shared/catalog/sounds.json, 'gm:<program>' for any SoundFont program, or 'rhythm' on the drums: the kit an app rhythm brings (its own sounds over the default kit).

melodic.description: Legacy (v1→v2). Migrated into the style on open.

app.description: What only the Flutter app models today (key, meter, mixer beyond volume, voicings, note lengths, per-section timbre/register overrides). The web keeps it untouched.

drumSounds.description: The sound the song gives each hand-percussion row of an app rhythm (perc1…perc12): 100 + a General MIDI percussion note. The app's project.drumSounds.

trackPattern.description: A groove edited by hand for one section, in the StylePattern vocabulary: rhythm rows (0–1 velocity per 16th), arpeggio cells, a melodic variation (scale degrees 1–8), a fill.

partSounds.description: The sound each part of the rhythm plays in this section, by track (a kit id for the drums): over its sounds and the song's. Keys intro, a, b, ending. The engine plays A's and B's from its two banks.

part.description: The rhythm's intro or ending, played by this section instead of its groove (variation A or B stays for when it goes back). A reference: under another rhythm it plays that one's. The app keeps the same choice as Section.part.

variation.description: Which variation the section plays: 0 (or absent) A, 1 B. The app's rhythms bring a B (or the section makes one: groove.bCreated); on the web's own rhythms B is the section's alt.

alt.description: Variation B of a section on one of the web's own rhythms: another arrangement of the same part, made as a copy of A. Sounds and silences are the section's.

stylePart.description: This section is a part of a rhythm's intro or ending, added with it: it plays that part's own patterns.

groove.description: This section's own version of an app rhythm (lib-N, app-id): only the tracks and the fill edited in it, as [step, packed engine step] pairs. See src/lib/groove.ts.

bCreated.description: The rhythm has no B and the section made one from A.

intro.description: The section's own intro (part: intro), against the rhythm's first intro part or, without one, its A.
